conditions: Terms §7(i) bars resale, redistribution, sublicensing or third-party access without prior written authorization. Obtain an executed white-label agreement naming Vrooli and its exact bundled application/customer use before any API use for downstream customers.

White-label page offers branded domain/pricing/customer onboarding; get signed scope, quote, model list, rate/fallback details, limits, service level, customer billing/key structure and DPA. White-label pricing is contract-based and distinct from PAYG examples.

For each model, maintain LLM API as gateway/contract supplier, actual serving provider(s), publisher and license as separate identities. Obtain downstream rights and account-level route availability for every model/provider combination before adding model rules.
Resolve Terms date mismatch (page header 2026-08-04 vs body 2026-06-12), upstream provider terms, data retention/training/regions, caching, service availability and customer responsibilities.
Provider agreement, supplier rule, model eligibility, trust and Vrooli price each require separate human review; keep all routes denied until then.
plan_rules.reason: Official white-label product expressly offers partner resale under own brand/domain/prices and model/customer controls, but standard Terms require prior written authorization. Candidate only for that documented custom agreement path.

research.model_reason: Live catalog and provider/publisher labels do not establish a specific route, upstream rights or account entitlement.
